label: XDCR Regular Expression
type: the JavaScript-flavoured regular-expression syntax usable within an xdcr:filtering-expression, alongside xdcr:filtering-expression's own SQL++-subset syntax. Case-sensitive matching.
evidence: The following JavaScript regular expressions (RegExes) can be used for XDCR Advanced Filtering.
Note that regular expressions are case-sensitive: a lowercase 'a' is distinct from an uppercase 'A'.
Matches are established by means of Regular Expressions and Filtering Expressions.
relates_to_competency_question: Can an XDCR filter use regular-expression matching, and does it follow the same case rules as SQL++?
